opening_log: HQ is 98.8 again. They will have news. Condor missed a sched. The eastern channel is on the sheet.

town_rumor.title: Town rumor
town_rumor.body: Porangatu says Marcos was called upriver. HQ already said reassignment. Same week, different stories.

condor_cry.title: Condor FLASH
condor_cry.body: They authenticated SIERRA and asked for water. Grid seven-four-niner. HQ said noted.

help_grid.title: HELP GRID
help_grid.body: Plus-two pad. They asked you not to tell the outpost everything. The eastern channel is waiting.

day_close: Night two. A friend missing. A party crying for help.
